behaviour: resin collection and propolis deposition, including increased collection under pathogen challenge

direction_semantics.accept: A plant resin source is directly reported as collected or deposited as propolis.
direction_semantics.unknown: A resin source is available without observed collection, absent from a list, or lacks a direct collection observation.

expected_outcome: This system is the most likely of the three to retain records through the assay join because propolis chemistry has extensive experimental coverage.
seed_query: honeybee propolis resin foraging plant source
europe_pmc_query: TITLE_ABS:(honeybee OR honey bee OR Apis mellifera) AND TITLE_ABS:(propolis OR resin) AND (foraging OR collection OR plant OR source) AND OPEN_ACCESS:Y
